meta.title: From One Drawing to Green Remodeling | 2026 Korea ESG Eco Expo
meta.description: Ninewatt's experiment: one real green-remodeling design drawing set turned into a 3D model, a quantity takeoff, a remodeling estimate and an energy simulation.

hero.title:
From one drawing
to green remodeling.
hero.desc: Our AI read one real green-remodeling design drawing set (DXF), built a 3D model and quantities from it, and used the same model to estimate the remodeling cost and the energy it would save.
hero.imageAlt: Exterior rendering of the 3D model built from the drawing, with the finishes noted on the drawing

highlights.saving: Heating and cooling energy saved (simplified simulation)

film.title: The 78-second film
film.disclaimer: Made from the real drawing, the 3D model and EnergyPlus results. The heat-loss scene is coloured by the simulation's U-values, not thermal imaging.

steps.title: Five steps
steps.intro: The first three steps come straight from the drawing. The last two reuse those results for an example estimate and a simplified simulation.

drawing.title: Read the drawing
drawing.desc: The architect's original DXF, as delivered: 14,682 lines, 396 dimensions, 38 layers.

rooms.title: Rooms and areas
rooms.desc: Closed regions between wall and window lines become 12 rooms. Where no partition line exists, the room is flagged for review.

model.title: 3D model
model.desc: A 3D model at the drawing's scale, with the finishes from the drawing notes. Overlaid on the elevation, the lines nearly match.

takeoff.title: Quantities and estimate
takeoff.desc: Floor, wall, facade and window areas are measured, and example unit prices are applied to the remodeling scope in the drawing.

energy.title: Energy simulation
energy.desc: The model's wall and window areas and orientations feed a simplified EnergyPlus simulation, before and after remodeling.

energy.title: How much energy would remodeling save?
energy.intro: We simulated the same building for one year, changing only the work specified in the drawing: 100 mm phenolic foam external insulation and low-e double-glazed windows.
energy.chartLabel: Annual heating and cooling loads before and after remodeling
assumptions: Wall and window areas and orientations measured on the 3D model built from the drawing (exterior walls {wall} ㎡, {windows} windows totalling {window} ㎡)
Before: wall U 1.0, window U 4.0 W/㎡K (assumed for an older building). After: wall U 0.16, window U 1.8 W/㎡K (drawing specification)
Roof, floor, infiltration (0.7 ACH), occupancy and lighting are the same in both cases. Ground-floor clinic conditioned weekdays 9–18, upstairs residence at all times
Tool: US DOE EnergyPlus 9.0 with Korean typical-year weather data (TMYx 2004–2018)
energy.note: A simplified simulation, not an official energy rating. Detailed assessment continues in Ninewatt's Energy Studio and GreenPlanner.

compare.title: Where heat escapes
compare.caption: The brighter the glow, the more heat escapes. Brightness is proportional to the U-values used in the simulation; this is not thermal imaging. Drag the slider to compare.

estimate.title: Green remodeling estimate (example)
estimate.intro: Quantities measured on the model, applied to the remodeling scope in the drawing.

items.insulation: External wall insulation (100 mm phenolic foam + stucco)
items.windows: Window replacement (PVC double sash, 24 mm low-e double glazing)

estimate.note: * Unit prices are examples assuming typical market rates for materials and labour, not a quote. Demolition, mechanical, electrical and roof work are not included.

connect.title: Connected to Ninewatt products
connect.intro: We are building it so the building data from a drawing can feed the simulation and decision tools we already run.

energyStudio.name: Energy Studio
energyStudio.desc: The existing-building energy and greenhouse-gas simulator of the Korea Authority of Land & Infrastructure Safety, upgraded and operated by Ninewatt.

greenplanner.name: GreenPlanner
greenplanner.desc: A remodeling decision service for building owners: energy diagnosis, construction cost, value forecast and government funding.

grai.name: GRAI
grai.desc: A green-remodeling simulation platform for public buildings: energy and carbon status, priorities and scenario analysis.

cta.title: Try it with your own building's drawings
cta.desc: We are looking for partners in green remodeling, design and construction, and public building assessment.

remodel.title: The green remodeling written in the drawing
remodel.intro: The two works noted on the construction drawings, applied to the same 3D model. The lower the U-value, the less heat escapes.
remodel.sectionAlt: Wall section: existing concrete, phenolic foam insulation and stucco added layer by layer
remodel.wrapAlt: The facade being re-clad from the bottom up
remodel.winSpec: PVC double sash · 24 mm low-e double glazing
